# netbox_fhrp_group_assignments (Data Source)

Retrieves all fhrp group assignments from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_fhrp_group_assignments" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "created"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "fhrp_group_assignments_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_fhrp_group_assignments.example.fhrp_group_assignments[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `fhrp_group_assignments` (Attributes List) The fhrp group assignments found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fhrp_group_assignments))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.

### Nested Schema for `fhrp_group_assignments`

- `interface` (String) The interface of the fhrp group assignments.
- `interface_id` (Number) The interface id of the fhrp group assignments.
- `interface_type` (String) The interface type of the fhrp group assignments.
- `last_updated` (String) When the fhrp group assignments was last changed.
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the fhrp group assignments.
